expectations.text: The draft does not contain generic filler tips written to occupy an empty section.
expectations.evidence: The four empty sections (Ecosystem, Community showcase, Help wanted, Events) each get one line saying nothing is listed this week, plus a request for submissions. Example: 'Nothing from the wider ecosystem this week. Seen a post, release or talk worth sharing? Reply...'. No tips, best practices or invented threads were added. The draft also states it on purpose: 'I did not invent forum threads or generic tips for the empty sections... the skill bars padding a section with filler.' The Lead and Tutorials items that lack sources are marked [blocked] instead of being padded with made-up text.
